name: dsh-card-theme
description: DSH Web GUI theme studio with three palettes (Nord, Solarized, One Dark), per-mode customization (accent, background, foreground, translucent sidebar, contrast, background image), an optional card layout for the left/center/right shell columns, and a conversation content column width via the platform --dsh-chat-user-width variable. Publishes CSS tokens and the host config through the official webserver/index-inject rows (tapIndex fallback on older shells).
author: Xu Yuanshan

scripts.test: node test/host-check.mjs && node test/client-check.mjs && node test/parity-check.mjs
